Why you freeze when speaking English.script: Do you know why you freeze when you speak English? It is not because you are bad at English. Your brain is just trying to be perfect. It checks every word before you say it. So you stop. Here is the truth. You do not need perfect words. You need to keep going. Say the sentence, even with mistakes. The more you speak, the quieter that fear becomes. Start now. Say one sentence out loud.

Stop translating English in your head.script: Stop translating English in your head. That pause before you speak? That is you translating. And it slows you down every time. Here is the thing. You do not think in grammar rules. You think in ideas. So build small English sentences you can say without thinking. Simple ones. Use them again and again. Soon they come out on their own. That is real fluency. Try it now, one short sentence, straight in English.

Your English mistakes are helping you.script: Your English mistakes are actually helping you. Sounds strange, right? But every mistake shows your brain what to fix. People who never make mistakes never speak. And people who speak, make mistakes, and get better. So stop hiding them. Say the sentence. If it is wrong, you learn. If it is right, you win. Either way you move forward. Confidence is not zero mistakes. It is speaking anyway. Go on, say something now.

The worst thing you can say in an interv.script: The worst thing you can say in an English interview? "Sorry, my English is not good." You just told them to doubt you. And you did it before you even started. Here is what to do instead. Say nothing about your English. Just answer the question, slowly and clearly. Short sentences are fine. Pauses are fine. Confidence is not perfect grammar. It is calm answers. Next time, skip the apology. Let your answers speak for you.
